PHASE.NAME: CLI Build Cleanup And Release Gate
PHASE.GOAL: Resolve FIX/L2 and FIX/L6, then run the full release-quality regression gate for the issue-resolution line.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: main.rs delegates command dispatch to the CLI schema module so command ownership is localized.
Docker image build uses explicit locked cargo release semantics without no-op feature flags and packages a GLIBC-compatible runtime image.

STEPS.step-1: Moved top-level Command dispatch into the CLI module through the RunCommand implementation.
STEPS.step-2: Reduced main.rs to tracing setup, CLI parsing, config loading, tokio runtime creation, and CLI dispatch delegation.
STEPS.step-3: Removed Dockerfile no-op --no-default-features, replaced unused protobuf/OpenSSL build packages with ca-certificates only after dependency audit, aligned the builder with Rust 1.95.0, copied embedded OpenCode assets, and used a GLIBC-compatible trixie runtime.
STEPS.step-4: Ran the full issue-resolution release gates after all fixes completed.
